Substitute \(y=\frac{x}{2}\) into \(z\):

\[
z=x^2-3x\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)+4\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^2=\frac{x^2}{2}.
\]

Then

\[
S=\frac{2}{x}+\frac{1}{x/2}-\frac{2}{x^2/2}+2
=\frac{4}{x}-\frac{4}{x^2}+2.
\]

Let \(t=\frac1x>0\). Then

\[
S=4t-4t^2+2=-4\left(t-\frac12\right)^2+3\le 3.
\]

The maximum is \(3\).

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
